annotations.title: Get Epa Echo Npdes Sewer Overflow History

description: Query normalized EPA ECHO NPDES all-version sewer overflow and bypass event rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use for amendment/replacement history by permit, state, year, event type, volume, current-report flag, and replacing payload IDs; add refresh/checksum policy before autonomous settlement.

current_only.description: If true, return only rows where EPA marks the report form as current.

event_type.description: Optional event type text filter, e.g. 'Sanitary Sewer Overflow', 'Combined Sewer Overflow', or 'Bypass'.

include_replaced.description: If false, exclude replaced or non-current report versions. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum event-version rows to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

min_volume_gallons.description: Optional minimum reported discharge volume in gallons.

state.description: Optional 2-character permit state prefix, e.g. 'IL', 'GA', 'PR', or 'TX'.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and count metadata without row payloads.

with_coordinates.description: If true, return only events with latitude and longitude.

year.description: Optional event year based on event start datetime or report start date.

name: get_epa_echo_npdes_sewer_overflow_history

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.
